table_query:
SELECT
  d.SalesOrderID,
  d.SalesOrderDetailID,
  h.SalesOrderNumber,
  h.CustomerID AS CustomerKey,
  d.ProductID  AS ProductKey,
  CAST(date_format(h.OrderDate, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT) AS OrderDateKey,
  CAST(date_format(h.DueDate, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)   AS DueDateKey,
  CAST(date_format(h.ShipDate, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)  AS ShipDateKey,
  h.Status,
  h.OnlineOrderFlag,
  h.TerritoryID,
  h.SalesPersonID,
  d.SpecialOfferID,
  d.CarrierTrackingNumber,
  d.OrderQty,
  d.UnitPrice,
  d.UnitPriceDiscount,
  d.LineTotal
FROM silver.yasilvermodel.Sales_SalesOrderDetail d
JOIN silver.yasilvermodel.Sales_SalesOrderHeader h
  ON h.SalesOrderID = d.SalesOrderID
column_expressions: CONCAT(IFNULL(CAST(`SalesOrderID` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`SalesOrderDetailID` AS STRING), 'NULL'))

CAST(UNHEX(SHA2(CONCAT(IFNULL(CAST(`SalesOrderNumber` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`OrderDateKey` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`DueDateKey` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`ShipDateKey` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Status` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`OnlineOrderFlag` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`TerritoryID` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`SalesPersonID` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`SpecialOfferID` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`CarrierTrackingNumber` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`OrderQty` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`UnitPrice` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`UnitPriceDiscount` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`LineTotal` AS STRING), 'NULL')), 256)) AS BINARY)

  `SalesOrderID` INT,

  `SalesOrderNumber` STRING,
  `CustomerKey` BINARY,
  `ProductKey` BINARY,
  `OrderDateKey` INT,
  `DueDateKey` INT,
  `ShipDateKey` INT,

  `TerritoryID` INT,
  `SalesPersonID` INT,
  `SpecialOfferID` INT,
  `CarrierTrackingNumber` STRING,
  `OrderQty` INT,
  `UnitPrice` DECIMAL(19,4),

  `LineTotal` DECIMAL(38,6),
  `SalesOrderLineKey_Id` BIGINT,
  `CustomerKey_Id` BIGINT,
